SMA.name: SMA
SMA.label: Simple Moving Average
SMA.description: A simple moving average (SMA) is a basic technical indicator that calculates the average price of an asset over a specified number of periods. It is used to smooth out price data and identify trends over time.

EMA.name: EMA
EMA.label: Exponential Moving Average
EMA.description: An exponential moving average (EMA) gives more weight to recent prices, making it more responsive to new information. It is used to identify trends and potential reversals.

SUPERTREND.name: SUPERTREND
SUPERTREND.label: Supertrend
SUPERTREND.description: The Supertrend indicator identifies trend direction by combining price and volatility. It acts as dynamic support or resistance, signaling buy or sell opportunities.

MACD.name: MACD
MACD.label: Moving Average Convergence Divergence
MACD.description: MACD measures the relationship between two EMAs to identify momentum and trend changes. It includes a signal line and histogram for trade signals.

VTX.name: VORTEX
VTX.label: Vortex Indicator
VTX.description: The Vortex indicator identifies trend direction and strength by comparing price highs and lows over a period, using POSITIVE_VI and NEGATIVE_VI lines.

LBB.name: LBB
LBB.label: Lower Bollinger Band
LBB.description: The Lower Bollinger Band is part of the Bollinger Bands, set below the moving average by a multiple of standard deviations, indicating potential oversold conditions.

UBB.name: UBB
UBB.label: Upper Bollinger Band
UBB.description: The Upper Bollinger Band is set above the moving average by a multiple of standard deviations, signaling potential overbought conditions.

MBB.name: MBB
MBB.label: Middle Bollinger Band
MBB.description: The Middle Bollinger Band is a moving average, typically simple or exponential, serving as the centerline for Bollinger Bands.

DMI.name: DMI
DMI.label: Directional Movement Index
DMI.description: The DMI measures trend strength and direction using +DI and -DI lines, often paired with ADX to confirm trends.

KELTNER.name: KELTNER
KELTNER.label: Keltner Channels
KELTNER.description: Keltner Channels use an EMA and ATR to create bands around price, identifying volatility and potential breakouts.

PSAR.name: PSAR
PSAR.label: Parabolic SAR
PSAR.description: Parabolic SAR places dots above or below price to indicate trend direction and potential reversal points.

FISHER.name: FISHER
FISHER.label: Fisher Transform
FISHER.description: The Fisher Transform converts price data into a Gaussian distribution to identify extreme price movements and reversals.

MFI.name: MFI
MFI.label: Money Flow Index
MFI.description: The Money Flow Index measures buying and selling pressure using price and volume, indicating overbought or oversold conditions.

VWAP.name: VWAP
VWAP.label: Volume Weighted Average Price
VWAP.description: VWAP calculates the average price weighted by volume, serving as a benchmark for intraday trading decisions.

TSI.name: TSI
TSI.label: True Strength Index
TSI.description: The True Strength Index measures price momentum with double-smoothed EMAs, signaling trend strength and reversals.

VO.name: VO
VO.label: Volume Oscillator
VO.description: The Volume Oscillator measures the difference between two volume moving averages, indicating changes in trading activity.

UO.name: UO
UO.label: Ultimate Oscillator
UO.description: The Ultimate Oscillator combines three timeframes to measure buying pressure, identifying overbought or oversold conditions.

OPEN.name: OPEN
OPEN.label: Open Price
OPEN.description: The opening price of an asset for a given period, used as a reference for price analysis.

HIGH.name: HIGH
HIGH.label: High Price
HIGH.description: The highest price of an asset during a given period, indicating peak market activity.

LOW.name: LOW
LOW.label: Low Price
LOW.description: The lowest price of an asset during a given period, indicating troughs in market activity.

CLOSE.name: CLOSE
CLOSE.label: Close Price
CLOSE.description: The closing price of an asset for a given period, commonly used for trend and momentum analysis.

VOLUME.name: VOLUME
VOLUME.label: Trading Volume
VOLUME.description: The total number of shares or contracts traded for an asset in a period, indicating market activity.

NUMBER.name: NUMBER
NUMBER.label: Number
NUMBER.description: A generic number indicator, which can be used for custom calculations or as a placeholder.

WMA.name: WMA
WMA.label: Weighted Moving Average
WMA.description: WMA assigns more weight to recent prices, making it more responsive to new information than a simple moving average.

TEMA.name: TEMA
TEMA.label: Triple Exponential Moving Average
TEMA.description: TEMA is a moving average that reduces lag by combining single, double, and triple EMAs.

MOM.name: MOM
MOM.label: Momentum
MOM.description: Momentum measures the rate of change in price, indicating the speed of price movements.

ROC.name: ROC
ROC.label: Rate of Change
ROC.description: ROC measures the percentage change in price between the current price and the price a certain number of periods ago.

RSI.name: RSI
RSI.label: Relative Strength Index
RSI.description: RSI measures the speed and change of price movements, identifying overbought or oversold conditions.

CCI.name: CCI
CCI.label: Commodity Channel Index
CCI.description: CCI measures the variation of price from its statistical mean, identifying cyclical trends.

MINUSDI.name: MINUSDI
MINUSDI.label: Minus Directional Indicator
MINUSDI.description: MinusDI measures the presence of a downtrend by comparing prior lows to current lows.

PLUSDI.name: PLUSDI
PLUSDI.label: Plus Directional Indicator
PLUSDI.description: PlusDI measures the presence of an uptrend by comparing prior highs to current highs.

MAMA.name: MAMA
MAMA.label: MESA Adaptive Moving Average
MAMA.description: MAMA adapts to price movement using the MESA algorithm, providing fast and slow lines for trend analysis.

WILLR.name: WILLR
WILLR.label: Williams %R
WILLR.description: Williams %R is a momentum indicator that measures overbought and oversold levels, similar to the stochastic oscillator.

DEMA.name: DEMA
DEMA.label: Double Exponential Moving Average
DEMA.description: DEMA is a moving average that places more weight on recent data, reducing lag compared to traditional EMAs.

ADX.name: ADX
ADX.label: Average Directional Index
ADX.description: The ADX measures trend strength by quantifying the strength of a price movement, regardless of direction.

ATR.name: ATR
ATR.label: Average True Range
ATR.description: ATR measures market volatility by decomposing the entire range of an asset price for that period.

AVGPRICE.name: AVGPRICE
AVGPRICE.label: Average Price
AVGPRICE.description: The average price is calculated as the mean of high, low, open, and close prices for a period.

STOCHRSIK.name: STOCHRSIK
STOCHRSIK.label: Stochastic RSI %K
STOCHRSIK.description: Stochastic RSI %K combines RSI and Stochastic oscillator concepts, measuring RSI's position within its own high-low range over a specific period.

STOCHRSID.name: STOCHRSID
STOCHRSID.label: Stochastic RSI %D
STOCHRSID.description: Stochastic RSI %D is a smoothed version of Stochastic RSI %K, providing a signal line for trend confirmation and crossover strategies.
